name: text-hover-effect

frames.best_why: Widest blue-teal glow along the S and H strokes, with the pointer visible beside them.

tagline: Giant outlined letters light up in blue around your cursor.
summary: An oversized single word drawn as a thin grey outline on black. Moving the pointer over it wipes in a patch of blue and teal along the letter strokes, like a torch on the text.
appearance: One large word fills the width in a heavy sans, rendered only as a thin grey outline with hollow letters on near-black. A soft blue-to-teal band lights the part of the outlines nearest the pointer.
behaviour: The outline traces itself once after load; after that a coloured glow trails the pointer across the letters, strongest at the cursor and fading with distance, and vanishes when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: The word STASH in capital letters.
search_phrases: outline text that glows on hover
hollow letters with a colour sweep
animated logo text for a landing page
use_when: A single short word such as a logo or name is the hero and you want a small reason to move the mouse.
avoid_when: Long text or body copy: the outline reads only as decoration, and the highlight is unreachable on touch screens.
customise: Only the word and an optional reveal duration are props; the grey stroke, gradient colours and font are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One SVG with three text copies and a mask; animation runs only on load and hover.

a11y.note: Hover-only reveal cannot be used from a keyboard or touch, and the SVG text gives screen readers no accessible label.

issues: At rest the letters sit at very low contrast against the black, nearly invisible until hovered.
Every frame shows the full outline already drawn, though the code traces it over four seconds.
polish_why: A restrained outline effect that reads well in motion, but the resting state is barely visible.
